family.label: preregistered cost contrasts, B minus A in dollars per trial

lead_note: A cost run: its preregistered contrasts compare cost per trial between harnesses on the same model, so its calls are about cost, not pass rate.

caveats: Lists Haiku as its housekeeping model (shipped default); it made no housekeeping calls.
Ran on the default Docker bridge while the other cells ran on the internal network, so the network is not held fixed in QM's contrast.
Uses Haiku for housekeeping (shipped default, metered inside its cost).
One request's stream timed out before its final usage, so the proxy kept its full reservation; that charge is in this cell's cost.
Dev tasks at these pins: a result here is not a held-out confirmation.
Each cell ran alone on its own Ubicloud VM, so wall-time differences are confounded with the machine.
Every cell is a plain harness: no gstack, no gbrain.
Cost per solved task is the cell's whole spend at list price through our metering proxy, divided by its passes.
On GPT-6.1 Sol the proxy bills every uncached prompt token at the cache-write rate, above OpenAI's input list price, because OpenAI caches prompts on its own; the Sol cells' costs include that rate.
Calls come only from the run's preregistered cost contrasts, each within one model; rows are in the run's own order, which is not a ranking.
